leftEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
leftEvidence.title: The twelve agree about the fruit and the strength of the inhabitants

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The men return to Moses, Aaron, and the assembly, show the fruit, and say the land flows with milk and honey.
points.right: The other men say Israel cannot go up because the inhabitants are stronger, and they spread an evil report about the land.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They also name strong people, fortified cities, descendants of Anak, and peoples occupying each region.
points.right: They describe a land that eats its inhabitants, unusually tall people, Nephilim, and themselves as grasshoppers.

payload.posture: The men first agree that the land flows with milk and honey, then the ten spread an evil report that it eats its inhabitants.

rightEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
rightEvidence.title: Ten men deny Israel’s ability and spread an evil report

payload.tension: The two descriptions stand in the same report sequence without an explanation of how the ten reconcile them.
payload.title: Fruitful land and land that consumes
